Rice does nothing at all. If you drop something into a conductive liquid you should first remove all batteries ASAP, this to prevent short circuits that could damage components... once done that you should open the gadget and clean it thoroughly (for instance with isopropyl alcohol) making sure you dry it all up before putting it all together.

Put back the batteries ONLY if you are sure that the PCB is dry and hope for the best.

If your game has spent years wet into a bag with rice... chances are that the tracks are destroyed by now... as i said, rice does nothing... but you might still have luck so before throwing it away open it up and take a good look inside, clean what you can with isopropyl alcohol and give it a try once dry.
